name: Roasted Butternut Squash Soup with Coconut Milk (Vegan)
ingredients:
For roasting:
1 medium butternut squash (about 2½ lb / 1.1 kg), halved lengthwise and seeds removed
1 red onion, halved
1 red bell pepper
2 carrots, peeled
2 heads garlic, tops sliced off
2 cups cherry tomatoes
3 tbsp olive oil
1 tsp ground cumin
1 tsp smoked paprika
1 tsp dried thyme
1 tsp dried rosemary
1 tsp salt
1/2 tsp black pepper
1/2 tsp chili flakes (optional)
For the soup:
1 1/2 cups vegetable broth, plus up to 1/2 cup more to thin
3/4 cup canned full-fat coconut milk, plus more to drizzle
1 tsp grated fresh ginger (optional)
To serve:
Chili oil or chili crisp
Chopped fresh parsley or cilantro
Toasted sourdough
directions:
Prep the squash: Preheat the oven to 425°F (220°C). Score the cut sides of the squash in a deep crosshatch and place the halves cut side up in a large roasting dish. Set an onion half, cut side down, into each seed cavity.
Load and season the tray: Add the bell pepper, carrots, garlic heads (cut side up) and cherry tomatoes around the squash. Drizzle everything with the olive oil, then sprinkle over the cumin, smoked paprika, thyme, rosemary, salt, pepper and chili flakes if using. Rub the seasoning into the squash flesh.
Roast: Roast 50–60 minutes, until a knife slides into the thickest part of the squash with no resistance, the garlic is golden and soft, and the tomatoes have burst. If the garlic is still pale, give it 5–10 more minutes on its own.
Blend: Let the tray cool 5 minutes. Scoop the squash flesh out of the skin into a blender, discarding the skin. Squeeze the garlic cloves out of their papers and add them, along with the onion, pepper, carrots, tomatoes and all the juices from the dish. Add the 1 1/2 cups broth (reserve the extra) and the ginger if using. Blend until completely smooth, working in two batches if your blender is small.
Finish with coconut milk: Pour the soup into a large pot over medium heat. Stir in the coconut milk and warm through 3–4 minutes. Add reserved broth until it's as thick or thin as you like. Taste and adjust the salt.
Serve: Ladle into bowls and top with a swirl of chili oil, a drizzle of coconut milk and chopped herbs. Serve with toasted sourdough.
notes:
Faster roasting: Peel and cube the squash (or buy pre-cut) and it's done in 30–35 minutes instead of 50–60. The smaller you cut everything, the faster it cooks.
Timing varies with squash size and oven — keep roasting until the flesh is completely tender, even past 60 minutes.
Blending hot soup: Fill the blender no more than two-thirds, remove the center cap of the lid, cover with a towel and start on low.
Coconut milk: Use canned, full fat. Carton coconut milk won't make the soup creamy.
Freezing: Freezes well up to 3 months. Freeze without toppings and whisk as it reheats.
